groups.title: Edge chamfering machines · value line
groups.lead: Bench chamfering machines and hand chamfering units for weld preps and clean edges on plate, strip and parts — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: For chamfers on smaller parts, the NovoTech value-line CMD-80 and CMD-4 bench machines cut 15 – 45° chamfers up to 1/4″ and 5/32″, and the DM5 and DM5A hand units 3/16″ at 45°.

set.hero_brand_line: Cevisa bevellers are made in Vitoria, Spain, by CEVISA — plate bevelling machines since 1969, ISO 9001, exported to more than 60 countries; NovoTech's value-line chamfering machines are built in China to NovoTech's specification. All sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.
